x: A turn-up was seen in Herne Hill Harriers 10 mile walking championship, the winner being D. H Sayer, who by beating Reddish and Presland, reversed the result of their 7 miles, in which he finished third.
…, no doubt, have welcomed a training spin as a respite from the keen struggle which always ensues when Presland, Sayer, Reddish and Co. are met in open competition.…

They were then lost to sight whilst a lap of some 6 miles was traversed, and when again seen, the field was headed by Sandy, Surrey A.C., with Vickers, Sheffield, in close attendance. Then came Plumb, N.L H., Reddish, H.H.H., and Ludlow, Derby W.C.
